title: Why Nitin Gadkari is the Worst Minister | Open Letter
description:
Nitin Gadkari is often praised for revolutionizing India's road and highway infrastructure — but is there more to the story? In this video, we take a closer look at his tenure as Minister of Road Transport and Highways. From record-breaking highway construction to major expressway projects, Gadkari’s work has drawn both admiration and criticism.

Is the praise justified, or are there gaps that mainstream narratives ignore? We break down the facts, the achievements, the controversies, and whether the label of “worst minister” holds any ground.
